about: Route parity for data (scripts/angelo/route_parity.py, doc/angelo/prompt_audit.rst "Route parity for data"). filters: where a route's presentation of a result leaves fields out. routes/forms/tools select it; at: the locations where it drops fields nobody has written yet (an allowlist: a new field there must be added to the code's list or to drops); drops: each field path it leaves out today, with its reason in reasons (the longest prefix's); review: OPEN gaps the maintainer has not decided (reported, never failed); drops_every_field: a form that keeps no field (reported). budgets: where a route cuts a result to a size. A path changes here when the code changes, never to make the corpus pass.

budgets.says: The next message's handoff keeps a result's first 5,000 characters (program_completion.history_result_text); the chat's activity row keeps the rest.

filters.says: A finished program's model copy (program_model_result.compact): every handle, revision, check and failure, and one row per object; the chat's activity row keeps the rest.

reasons.changes.added: A created object's added row is left out when its live row, matched by identity, states it with its geometry.
reasons.changes.scope: Scope sentences the tool description states (program_model_result.DELTA_SCOPES).
reasons.delta.scope: Scope sentences the tool description states (program_model_result.DELTA_SCOPES).
reasons.delta.geometry_scope: Scope sentences the tool description states (program_model_result.DELTA_SCOPES).
reasons.checks: A passed check is its inner rows: what was checked and the values observed, without the repeated verdict, wrapper or echoed scope (CHECK_WRAPPER, CHECK_STATUS).
reasons.delta.added: A committed result's delta rows: its changes list the same objects.
reasons.delta.modified: A committed result's delta rows: its changes list the same objects.
reasons.delta.removed: A committed result's delta rows: its changes list the same objects.
reasons.delta.geometry[].matrix: Bounds to 1 mm and vertex and face counts stand for the matrix and full mesh counts; angelo_scene_object returns them by handle (GEOMETRY_DROPPED).
reasons.delta.geometry[].mesh_counts: Bounds to 1 mm and vertex and face counts stand for the matrix and full mesh counts; angelo_scene_object returns them by handle (GEOMETRY_DROPPED).
reasons.delta.geometry[].type: The object's type, which its live row states (ECHO).
reasons.live_revisions.note: The live rows' constant note: the instructions state how to bind them.
reasons.operation_results[].object_type: An operation read-back without the type its object's row states (ECHO).

filters.says: A Claude plan's verify round sends a fresh turn observation with the results (model_results.OBSERVED, observation_follows).

reasons.verified: The observation states the scene's name and object count.
reasons.after.scene_settings: The observation's scene entry states the scene settings and their revision.
reasons.after: An after with no object rows is left out once its scene settings are (the observation states them).

filters.says: A certified program in the next message's handoff: one verified line (the outcome, the changed objects, every passed check with its observed values) plus a preview's ID, view IDs, isolated shared data and the live rows the same message's observation does not show (claude_outcomes.terse_receipt). Claude and Codex plan threads both read it.

reasons.changes: The verified line names the added and modified objects (claude_outcomes._changes); the live rows carry their handles.
reasons.checks: The verified line states every passed check with the scalar values it observed; true flags are implied by passing.
reasons.delta: A committed result's delta repeats its changes, which the verified line names; the next message's observation shows the objects' current state.
reasons.live_revisions: The entry keeps each live row's handle, name and revision (program_completion.LIVE_FIELDS); the observation shows the rest.
reasons.operation_results: Per-operation read-backs: the verified line states the outcome and every check.
reasons.verified: The commit's verification bookkeeping; the verified line states the outcome.
reasons.views: A view's file, kind and size; the entry keeps its ID and name.
reasons.preview_id: A committed result's empty preview_id; a preview's ID is kept.
reasons.preview_note: A preview's constant note; the verified line says the scene is unchanged until Accept.
reasons.readable_summary: A preview's summary; the verified line names the staged changes.
reasons.program_id: The host's program ID, never bound by a model.
reasons.mutation_started: Outcome flags: a certified result is committed in one Undo step with no partial change, which the verified line states (any other flag keeps the whole result).
reasons.partial_changes_possible: Outcome flags: a certified result is committed in one Undo step with no partial change, which the verified line states (any other flag keeps the whole result).
reasons.scene_changed: Outcome flags: a certified result is committed in one Undo step with no partial change, which the verified line states (any other flag keeps the whole result).
reasons.undoable: Outcome flags: a certified result is committed in one Undo step with no partial change, which the verified line states (any other flag keeps the whole result).
reasons.undo_published: Outcome flags: a certified result is committed in one Undo step with no partial change, which the verified line states (any other flag keeps the whole result).
reasons.changes.modified: An empty modified list; the verified line names the modified objects when there are any (claude_outcomes._changes).
reasons.checks[].checks[].observed.space: The space a check measured in echoes the check's own validated space (validation_checks: its argument or default); _terse_values leaves it out with scope and states the measured values.

filters.says: A Codex plan's correction prompt after an item failed: each committed item before it as compact_receipt (identities, changed object names, commit facts).

reasons.changes: The receipt keeps each changed object's name and type, or name and changed fields.
reasons.delta: A committed result's delta repeats its changes, which the receipt lists.
reasons.live_revisions: The receipt keeps each live row's handle, name, type, role, alias and revision.
reasons.operation_results: Per-operation read-backs; the receipt keeps the identities a corrected plan binds with.
reasons.views: A view's file, kind and size; the receipt keeps its ID and name.
reasons.preview_id: A committed result's empty preview_id; a preview's ID is kept.
reasons.readable_summary: A preview's summary; the receipt lists the staged changes.
reasons.program_id: The host's program ID, never bound by a model.
reasons.mutation_started: Outcome flags of a clean commit (an unclean one keeps the whole result).
reasons.partial_changes_possible: Outcome flags of a clean commit (an unclean one keeps the whole result).
reasons.scene_changed: Outcome flags of a clean commit (an unclean one keeps the whole result).
reasons.undo_published: Outcome flags of a clean commit (an unclean one keeps the whole result).
reasons.undoable: Outcome flags of a clean commit (an unclean one keeps the whole result).
reasons.changes.modified: An empty modified list; the receipt keeps each modified object's name and changed fields when there are any.
